invalidated_single_seed_runner.reason: uses core.build_workload, whose predicted_slack is derived from trace-realized output/service, and omits predicted_slack from the universe hash

hardware_topology.placement: even source ranks use same-node Peer-HBM/local DRAM; odd ranks use cross-node Peer-HBM/remote DRAM; route mappings are bijective

workload.slack_predictor: independent registered output distribution v1; never reads realized output or realized service
workload.same_universe_rule: For a fixed seed all six policies receive byte-identical tasks including predicted_slack_ms.

failure_conditioning.probe_time_rule: 48 policy-independent equal strata over [0,90000] ms; alternating worker/node type, deterministic rank/time from seed XOR 0x5A1F311
failure_conditioning.same_probe_rule: the exact same probe tuple and failure-domain rank set is replayed for all six policies within a seed
failure_conditioning.primary_sample: all workflows on the common denominator after each independently conditioned single fault probe
failure_conditioning.pooled_cdf_boundary: pooled probe-workflow observations are descriptive only; probes are not treated as independent seeds

statistics.pooled_cdf: descriptive ECDF over every retained probe-workflow observation; exact samples remain in immutable per-cell NPZ
statistics.paired_ci: two-sided paired Student-t 95% CI across ten seeds for each non-Native architecture minus Native on the same seed/domain
statistics.absolute_ci: two-sided Student-t 95% CI across ten seed-level metrics for each architecture/domain

figure_grammar.kind: two-panel worker/GPU and source-node failure-conditioned WCT ECDF
figure_grammar.rendering: exact pooled samples reduced only by deterministic uniform ECDF index decimation to at most 4000 vector points per curve; no tail or policy sample selection

gate.purpose: exact display mapping, no-oracle workload, common probe/domain hashes, three control windows, capacity/copy conservation; no performance direction gate

hard_gates: exact six display names and display-to-internal mapping
all source file hashes match preregistration
old core.build_workload single-seed lineage is rejected
predicted_slack_ms is included in the common workload universe hash
all 60 registered cells and every raw NPZ are retained
same workload, probe tuple, and failure-domain rank-set hashes across all six policies per seed
worker failure invalidates exactly one source rank and node failure exactly eight source ranks
exactly 24 worker and 24 node probes per full seed with stratified exposure spanning the 90 s horizon
exact 30/60/90 ms registered controller opportunities; AegisKV executes exactly three
empty-fault replay exactly preserves healthy completion and faults never lower WCT
copy byte conservation, physical target conservation, and shared-HBM capacity hold
no future backup projection, seal-before-dispatch, or realized-output oracle
no performance win, architecture ordering, node-domain discrimination, or monotonicity threshold
evidence_boundary: Ten-seed preliminary metadata DES. A100 bandwidths, 500 ms activation, and 60 s Native replacement are modeled/unmeasured; Native Mooncake and five architecture components are modeled adapters rather than production deployments. Pooled CDFs are descriptive and paired seed CIs are the inferential result.
